scope: network packet, protocol, and flow mechanisms only

runtime_capacity.capacity_gap: The fixed v4 runtime can hold only 48 additional nodes. Broader network coverage requires a separately versioned runtime and pack migration.

coverage.owner: imperium-net-observer and v5 authored network curriculum
coverage.gap: Parser success alone is not a service or identity decision.
The current parser identifies fragments but no verified reassembly owner supplies a complete transport packet.
Per-flow SYN/ACK, sequence/window, payload-length and lifetime tracking require matched live tests; raw header fields are not progression proof.
UDP is connectionless; reverse tuple alone does not establish a permitted reply or a live service policy.
IPv4 type/code/identifier/sequence are parsed; matching request/reply state and a live service rule are not yet verified.
The mesh has signed handshakes and replay mechanics, but the current v5 registry has not pinned current code hashes or a host admission receipt tying them to each payload.
No current versioned approved zone/endpoint/service/direction configuration exists in the node.
Held-out live false-pass/false-reject matrix remains unrun.

open_frontier.reason: A v5 diagnostic-3 world relation is authored, but the live observer still does not seed ICMPv6 echo request/reply.
Current observer recognizes bounded extension framing but not every extension option or updated RFC 9673 behavior.
Application semantics and encrypted contents are not inferred from ports or payload text.
These network mechanisms need separate source-bound packet and temporal controls.
Opaque protection context cannot be inferred from an IP next-header value.
RawIp TUN observations omit Ethernet/ARP and privileged raw layer-2 send paths.
Original v4 source registry, split manifest, world.json, geometry.json, and trainer are absent from this checkout.
A passive graph path from packet context to authorized_flow cannot release traffic without independently validated, current host policy and flow-state facts plus complete edge conditions.
All diagnostic-2 validation, sealed-test, and cross-composition groups are exposed by its failed run and cannot be reused as fresh holdouts.
The current 256-node bitmap cannot represent an open-ended network catalog.
